notes: Two independent native-green, pure public-API Annex C.3 negative scenarios use separate pairs of adapter-owned, schema-valid DIF modules. The enumerated pair assigns one value to two different enumerator names. The HLAvariantRecord pair keeps the same valid enumerated discriminant but changes the set of alternatives on one named non-extendable record. Each module creates a federation alone; the combined pair raises InconsistentFOM; a valid retry reuses the name. Installed-package CTest and direct runner passed 8/8 each across both callback models. Java parity compiles against the API-only JAR but Java provider runtime is unverified. No private FOM catalog, other merge branches, interoperability, or conformance is claimed.
